Only the stock (6 100 received, 2 261 left), the pre-registered group of 4 428 and the 86.7% repeat SR191. No daily count is printed or derived. SR190 printed 3 522 people and 4 100 doses received. Not comparable with other provinces' rows, which count different populations; there is no national total. The SitRep does not name the vaccine product.
